facts.text: I am planning a college reunion with my old friends and need help finding a venue.
My WhatsApp group is named "College Friends Reunion".
There are 10 members in my WhatsApp group.
We have exchanged over 500 messages so far in the WhatsApp group.
I am looking for a venue in my city for a group of 10-20 people.
I think a private dining room in a restaurant would be a great option for the reunion.
I plan to search online for restaurants in my area that have private dining rooms.
I plan to combine keywords like "private dining room," "group dining," and my city name in my search query.
I want to ask the restaurant if they have audio-visual equipment like a projector or screen.
I want to use the audio-visual equipment to do a slideshow or presentation during the reunion.
I plan to ask the restaurant about audio-visual equipment when I contact them.
I want to ask about other amenities the restaurant might offer, like whiteboards or flipcharts.
